events.title: Cyber-safety demo — unexpected Karan–Aman encounter and brief wardrobe slip
flags: Confirmed by author: all three remember the unexpected college meeting/accident and later talk with previous familiarity.
The exact prose and dialogue are still draft; no adult romance or physical incident is automatically implied.
Karan and Aman independently attend as adult career-prep visitors and leave before Ankita's evening pickup. Beat10 station cast unchanged.
events.detail: During a public, career-relevant cyber-safety demonstration, Shreya unexpectedly meets already-familiar society twins Karan and Aman. A loose backpack strap briefly catches a display stand, they prevent it falling, and a few of her papers drop. As she bends to retrieve them, the previously unbuttoned first/top button collar shifts forward for an instant, unintentionally revealing a small amount of the upper breast/cleavage area to both men from the side. She immediately straightens and fixes her uniform. Karan briefly stops joking; Aman discreetly returns a folder. Shreya has a moment of private, confused awareness, then the session returns to ordinary safety instruction. No deliberate display, further touch or extended embarrassment. Shared memory: all three remember the brief incident; normal teasing resumes and it remains a discreet private observation. No intrusive callbacks.

beats.title: Unplanned reunion
beats.body: Shreya sees Karan by management/career guidance and Aman near technical recruitment guidance. They converge near her open-awareness session and all are surprised; nobody knew Shreya was the guest officer. Add an easy callback to their morning parking-gate banter: all three speak with prior familiarity, not like strangers. Shreya teases their constant appearances but retains professional control.
beats.internal: Audience ke familiar chehre dekhkar Shreya ka ek pal ke liye focus badla. Karan ki usual grin aa gayi; Aman seedha khada hokar calmly hello bola.

beats.title: A relevant demonstration
beats.body: Shreya's public demonstration covers suspicious recruiter emails and account safety. Aman recognizes a fraudulent technical login link; Karan notices fake time pressure in an apparent management internship offer. Both contribute without taking attention from her official work.
beats.internal: Shreya ne sample message screen par rakha. Aman ne fake sender-domain point out kiya aur Karan ne 'apply in five minutes' pressure catch kar liya.

beats.title: Single accidental wardrobe moment
beats.body: While Karan turns near the booth, his backpack strap catches the loose edge of a lightweight display stand. Aman catches the tilting stand; a few Shreya handouts fall. When Shreya bends to collect them, her already open top uniform neckline briefly shifts enough that both men unintentionally glimpse a small upper part of her breasts/cleavage from the side. No second button opens. She rises, adjusts the uniform immediately; both avert their gaze. No touching, tearing, intentional exposure or extended view.
beats.internal: Karan ka backpack strap stand mein atka aur Aman ne usse girne se bachaya. Kuch handouts neeche gire. Shreya ne jhukkar papers uthaye; uska pehle se loose top collar ek pal ko shift hua. Teeno ne incident register kiya, Shreya ne shirt set ki aur kisi ne isay badhaaya nahi. Accident ke baad baat seedha demonstration par aa gayi.

beats.title: Awareness and a quick return to normal
beats.body: Karan, normally a joker, goes briefly quiet. Aman returns Shreya's folder while looking at the printed handout. Shreya infers they may have seen the accidental glimpse, feels a short confused/private self-consciousness, and then treats it as a minor interruption instead of a public incident. She cannot know their internal thoughts, nor does this imply consent to further attention.
beats.internal: Shreya ne pal-bhar ko socha ki dono ne note kiya hoga; Karan ki unusually restrained smile aur Aman's practical help usse yaad rahi. Phir usne unko waise hi halka tease kiya jaise subah parking gate par karti thi. Karan wapas natural masti mein aa gaya aur Aman quietly focus se answer deta raha. Kisi ne awkward moment ki visibility par direct comment nahi kiya.

beats.title: Session normalizes and ends
beats.body: Shreya completes the public cyber-safety session. Karan returns to light banter about career readiness while Aman asks an actual verification question. Their normal behavior, not additional exposure, signals that the awkward minute has passed. Familiar teasing naturally returns before the goodbye; all three can recall the incident afterward without treating the wardrobe moment as a joke or an invitation to repeat it.
beats.internal: Agle examples mein conversation phir safe links, reporting aur practical screening par aa gayi. College mein Shreya guest officer hi rahi; kisi ne accident ko topic nahi banaya.

events.detail: Samar and Shaan are legitimately setting up their society's New Year fitness activity, testing resistance handles and a low marked balance strip rather than waiting around for Shreya. Shreya sees a misaligned marker and chooses to give the equipment a quick trial. Samar's palm-to-palm partner resistance feels initially familiar, but an unexpected shared step brings his hand to the outside of her upper arm as he stabilizes the strap handle; Shreya feels a brief charged surprise, notices he did not exploit the moment and keeps participating voluntarily. Shaan then quietly checks the balance strip and, after asking permission to steady her, offers his forearm and for one short shift supports the outside of her clothed waist. The stillness and trust-based proximity feel unexpectedly different to Shreya from Samar's overt competitive energy. She notices a faster heartbeat and heightened awareness, steps away on her own, and restores their ordinary teasing without revealing private feelings. No repeated falls, staged clothing accidents, chest contact or implied consent to further physical contact. Both pending bets stay conditional.

beats.title: Why they are at the courtyard
beats.body: As sports volunteers, both twins are preparing the New Year society activity: Samar tests the partner-resistance bands, Shaan marks the low balance strip and checks safe clearance. After the police duty drive, Shreya walks by in the same navy training tee and black trousers, recognizes their familiar workout voices, and voluntarily stops for a quick look.
beats.internal: Courtyard mein resistance bands aur floor markers set ho rahe the. Samar ne Shreya ko dekhte hi smile ki, Shaan ne marker check karte hue sir uthaya. Shreya ka ponytail din bhar ki training ke baad thoda loose tha; usne file bag kandhe par adjust kiya.

beats.title: The bet returns, Shreya chooses the demonstration
beats.body: Samar jokes about his lost plank/coffee bet. Shaan mentions his own balance/saree wager without turning it into a demand. Shreya offers to test one partner drill to see whether the equipment is ready, not as payment for either bet.
beats.internal: Samar ne band ka handle uthaya aur cheeky tareeke se Shreya ki taraf badhaya. Shaan usse chhedne ke bajaye quietly anchor point dikha raha tha. Shreya ne apna bag bench par rakha; trial usne khud choose kiya.

beats.title: Samar — competitive touch becomes unexpectedly personal
beats.body: Samar and Shreya face each other for the deliberately agreed palm-to-palm partner-pressure test, feet positioned on flat ground. He matches her resistance; for two counts she leans harder than expected and changes her stance. He safely releases pressure and briefly steadies the outside of her clothed upper arm while the handle slackens. Her hand comes to rest against his forearm for one beat, and both ease apart. It is the first shift from ordinary exercise pressure to unexpected mutual proximity in this scene. Nobody makes another contact without choosing it.
beats.internal: Shreya ne palms set kiye aur pressure badhaya. Samar ne rhythm match ki. Jab handle ka tension halka hua, usne reflex se Shreya ke upper arm ko support diya—bas ek beat ke liye. Shreya ki ungliyan uski forearm par thamiin; uska pulse achanak tez laga. Dono ne grip release kar di. Samar ke chehre par challenge wali grin thi, lekin usne moment ka show nahi banaya.

beats.title: Shaan — stillness catches Shreya by surprise
beats.body: Shaan points out one crooked balance-strip marker and fixes it before testing. Unlike a risky wobbling platform, the strip is safe, flat, and low. Shreya offers to cross it in one continuous line; he asks whether she wants a spotter. She agrees. As she transitions weight onto the narrow marked strip, she takes his forearm for support and he briefly steadies her clothed side waist on her request to hold position. She can safely step away at any moment. The close, quiet coordination unexpectedly charges her awareness more than its practical purpose suggests; she finishes and steps away naturally.
beats.internal: Shaan ne low marker seedha kiya. 'Spotter chahiye?' usne poocha. Shreya ne haath badhaya. Ek chhote weight-shift par uski grip Shaan ki forearm par aa gayi aur usne Shreya ki clothed side waist ko ek pal support diya. Courtyard ka shor waisa hi tha, par us ek second mein Shreya ko contact unusually noticeable laga. Agle step par usne khud balance le liya aur distance bana li.

beats.title: A brief charged after-effect without a speech
beats.body: Shreya adjusts her ponytail and sleeves, subtly grounding herself after two different contacts. Samar is already joking about being scored for the effort, Shaan is straightening equipment. She notices her quickened heartbeat and the dissonance of an ordinary training exercise feeling newly personal; she does not confide that thought, freeze or act as though a romance has begun.
beats.internal: Shreya ne ek baar gehri saans li aur ponytail sahi ki. Touch bas workout jitna hi tha, phir bhi do alag tareekon se uska dhyaan kheench gaya. Usne chehre par usual half-smile laayi aur dono ke results announce kar diye.

beats.title: Wagers deferred, next meeting organic
beats.body: The twins have tasks to finish and Shreya has a home-bound route past the security desk. Neither coffee nor saree-get-together is granted; she offers a possible safety demo challenge on a later date under her conditions. Their existing joking rhythm resumes. Shreya walks on, aware of the interactions but not pulled into a manufactured extra gym session.
beats.internal: Samar band fold karne laga; Shaan marker tape lapet raha tha. Shreya ne bag uthaya aur society desk ki taraf chal di. Courtyard ke corner se unki usual nok-jhonk sunai deti rahi.
